name: Old BGLD token burns from its pairs' balances without sync
summary: The old BlackGold (BGLD) token's deflationary transfer burns from a liquidity pair's own balance without sync(), so the attacker skimmed the imbalance out of the BGLD/WBNB pair and ran the surplus through the BGLD/DEBT-USDT route, draining both pairs' quote assets.
notes: The token has been unchanged since it was set up in 2021. Loss is the two pairs' USDT and WBNB; their BGLD and DEBT are valued at nothing (rule 12).
